name: creatorconnect
description: CreatorConnect — a marketplace for finding social media creators for paid sponsorships and collaborations.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n marketplace,admin -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:marketplace" "npm:dev:admin"
scripts.build:marketplace: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w marketplace
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w admin
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:marketplace && npm run build:admin
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test:admin && npm run test:marketplace
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @creatorconnect/shared && npm run typecheck -w admin && npm run -w marketplace build -- --configuration development
